fields.user396\n\n 2013-07-27 09:26\n\n ~0030:
There are two possibilities to select the output file (see attached image: "descendants lines gui.jpg"):

Report Options --> "Output format" and "Destination"
no automatic file extend
correct output if file extend is correct and the file is manually opened
no automatic Open
Document Options --> "Output format" and Filename
automatic file extend
empty output
optional automatic Open

So it seems, the second option (Gramps standard) doesn't help the user at the moment
